Firehouse Subs Menu: What’s New and Most Popular

Firehouse Subs has long been a favorite among sub lovers, known for its bold flavors, fresh ingredients, and commitment to community support. If you’re a fan of hearty sandwiches, unique combos, and a variety of subs, this guide will provide detailed insights into what’s new and most popular on the Firehouse Subs menu.

We’ll dive into the hot and cold subs, combos, limited-time offers, and more to help you make the best choice when ordering at Firehouse Subs. Whether you’re opting for delivery, takeout, or dining in, Firehouse has a wide range of delicious options to explore.

What’s New?

Firehouse Subs continues to innovate with new and exciting menu items. Among the latest additions are new hot specialty subs featuring bold flavor combinations like the Spicy Cajun Chicken and the Smokehouse Beef, both of which offer unique blends of ingredients for a satisfying meal.

In addition, Firehouse has added new cold subs, such as the Turkey Bacon Ranch and the Tuna Salad, designed for lighter but equally delicious lunch options. Keep an eye out for limited-time offers that introduce seasonal favorites, often featuring premium ingredients like pastrami and specialty sauces.

Whether you’re craving a hot, hearty sub, or a cold, refreshing option, Firehouse Subs has got you covered.

Here’s a breakdown of some of the most popular Firehouse Subs menu items that customers rave about:

Hot Specialty Subs

Firehouse Subs is famous for its Hot Specialty Subs, each crafted with high-quality meats, melted cheeses, and served on a toasted sub roll. These subs are packed with flavors that keep customers coming back. Below is a closer look at some of the top choices, along with pricing:

Sub Name Ingredients Price
Smokehouse Beef & Cheddar Brisket Smoked beef brisket, melted cheddar cheese, tangy barbecue sauce, and mayonnaise on a toasted sub roll $8.99 / $11.99
Spicy Cajun Chicken Sub Cajun-seasoned chicken breast, house-made cajun mayo, melted Monterey Jack cheese, zesty cherry peppers, lettuce $8.49 / $11.49
Turkey Bacon Ranch Sliced turkey, crispy bacon, melted Monterey Jack cheese, lettuce, tomato, and ranch dressing $7.99 / $10.99

These Hot Specialty Subs are popular for their rich and bold flavors. The Smokehouse Beef & Cheddar Brisket stands out with its smoky brisket and tangy barbecue sauce, while the Spicy Cajun Chicken Sub offers a spicy kick. For a classic yet hearty choice, the Turkey Bacon Ranch combines fresh turkey with crispy bacon and creamy ranch.

Whether you’re dining in or ordering takeout, these hot subs are a must-try on the Firehouse Subs menu!

Limited-Time Offers

Firehouse Subs frequently introduces limited-time offers, featuring exclusive subs and deals that you won’t want to miss. These items change seasonally, so check your local restaurant for availability.

Ordering Firehouse Subs Online

You can order Firehouse Subs online for delivery or takeout. Visit their website or app to browse the delivery menu, choose your preferred items, and complete your order for a fast and easy experience.

  • Delivery fee: Starting at $0 (may vary based on location).
  • Takeout from Firehouse Subs: Available at all locations.

Firehouse Subs partners with popular food delivery platforms like UberEats, DoorDash, and GrubHub to offer a seamless ordering experience.

Frequently Asked Questions

Q1: Does Firehouse Subs offer a vegetarian menu?
Yes, Firehouse Subs has several vegetarian options, including the Veggie Sub, made with sautéed bell peppers, mushrooms, melted provolone, cheddar, and Monterey Jack cheeses, served fully involved®.

Q2: Can I customize my order online?
Absolutely! You can order online and customize your sub by adding or removing ingredients, choosing different bread, or selecting sides.

Q3: Does Firehouse Subs deliver to my area?
Check their website to see if delivery is available in your location. Delivery fees may vary depending on your distance from the restaurant.

Q4: Are there gluten-free options?
While Firehouse Subs offers salads and some sides that are gluten-free, their subs contain gluten.

Conclusion

In conclusion, Firehouse Subs continues to impress with a diverse and flavorful menu. Whether you’re a fan of their classic hot specialty subs or prefer a lighter salad, the Firehouse Subs menu has something for everyone. Don’t forget to keep an eye out for limited-time offers and combos to get the most value from your meal.
